subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing an author's distinctive voice and style across multiple works
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares short excerpts from the same author across different works, noting consistent stylistic features
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a stylistic feature (sentence length, diction, imagery pattern) to the author known for it
exercise.abstract: Student identifies elements of an author's distinctive voice and explains how they recur across works

misconception_flags: identifies a feature present in only one excerpt as if it were characteristic of the author's overall style

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
